name: rootlinkd
author: DAWN

sections.description:
rootlinkd automatically turns exact keywords and phrases into internal links across your WordPress content.

Set one keyword or phrase and one internal destination URL. When that exact text appears in eligible rendered content, rootlinkd creates the internal link automatically. Your posts are never rewritten: links are added as each page is displayed, so changing or deleting a rule updates every page at once.

Free includes:

  • Unlimited internal-link rules
  • One exact keyword or phrase and one internal destination URL per rule
  • Whole-word, case-insensitive matching
  • Every eligible exact match is linked, including headings (H1-H6) and the main singular post/page title
  • Links inherit the active WordPress theme’s normal link appearance
  • Existing links and technical markup are protected from nested or corrupt links
  • Works with Gutenberg, Elementor and the Classic Editor

Pro adds placement and volume control: a maximum number of links per page, linking each keyword once per page, skipping headings and titles, skipping the first paragraphs, excluding the current page, and turning auto-links off on individual posts or pages. It also adds external links, trusted domains (your own other sites treated as internal), one keyword variation per rule and five link styles.

Business adds affiliate links with rel="nofollow sponsored", automatic affiliate tag appending, click counts and analytics, a link randomizer, CSV import and export, up to five keyword variations per rule and three more link styles.

Developer adds unlimited keyword variations and destination URL autocomplete.

rootlinkd was previously named DAWN Auto Links.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate rootlinkd.
  2. Open rootlinkd -> Rules.
  3. Add an exact keyword or phrase and an internal destination URL.
  4. The Free edition automatically links every eligible exact match it finds.
sections.faq:
How many rules can I create in Free?

Unlimited. The Free edition has no rule-count quota.

How many links can Free add to one page?

Free has no links-per-page or once-per-keyword control. Every eligible exact match can be linked.

Will Free link inside headings or titles?

Yes. H1-H6 content and the main singular post/page title are eligible. Paid editions provide placement controls. Archive, navigation, and secondary-loop titles remain protected where linking could create invalid nested anchors.

Does Free have a Settings or Analytics page?

No. Free provides the exact-match internal-link engine and Rules management.

Does Free support keyword variations, external links, or affiliate links?

No. Those are paid features.

Can Free exclude the first paragraph or specific pages?

No. Placement and exclusion controls are paid features.

What does Free protect?

rootlinkd does not create nested links inside an existing <a> element and does not modify script, style, code, preformatted, textarea content, or HTML tag attributes.

Do my rules carry over when I upgrade?

Yes. Free and paid editions share the same rules table and settings, so data carries across upgrades.

Does deleting the plugin delete my rules?

No. Rules and settings stay in your database, so reinstalling brings them back.

Was this plugin previously called DAWN Auto Links?

Yes. It was renamed to rootlinkd in version 2.5.21. Your rules and settings carry over unchanged.
sections.changelog:
2.5.24

  • Fixed: editing a rule in Free failed with “The link you followed has expired”; the rule form now posts to the clean Rules URL (this also fixes adding a rule right after Delete/Enable/Disable)
  • Removed the legacy DAWN Auto Links icon from the bundled Freemius assets
  • Plugin classes renamed to the plugin’s existing dawnal prefix (Dawnal_Free_Plugin, Dawnal_Premium_Plugin); the Free package no longer references the premium class
  • No database, option, rule, settings, feature-gate or pricing changes

2.5.23

  • Author URI now points to the About page (https://rootlinkd.com/about/) so it differs from the Plugin URI
  • No functional, database, option, rule, feature-gate or licensing changes

2.5.22

  • Corrected upgrade promotion text: removed “Unlimited link rules” from the PRO upsell (every edition, including Free, has unlimited rules); “click tracking” wording now reads “click counts” to match what each plan shows
  • Settings help text and placeholders now use neutral examples (example.com) instead of real site and affiliate IDs
  • No functional, database, option, rule, feature-gate or licensing changes

2.5.21

  • Renamed from DAWN Auto Links to rootlinkd (plugin name, slug, text domain and admin menu)
  • Upgrade tab corrected: site counts per plan, removed support-level and “unlimited rules” claims
  • No database, option, rule or settings changes; existing rules and settings carry over

2.5.20

  • Code-quality cleanup in paid editions (input sanitization, output escaping, inline script formatting); no Free changes

2.5.19

  • Plugin Check cleanup: removed a WordPress 6.1-only cache function from the settings migration so the plugin stays compatible with WordPress 5.0+
  • Debug logging now writes only when WP_DEBUG and WP_DEBUG_LOG are enabled
  • Tightened input sanitization on the Add/Edit Rule form

2.5.18

  • Fixed Premium “Skip first paragraphs” leaking auto-links into Elementor opening content when DAL received a widget fragment before the assembled page content
  • When first-paragraph exclusion is enabled, DAL now defers Elementor per-widget linking and applies the placement rule to assembled content instead
  • Hardened paragraph-boundary handling so paragraph-less/fewer-than-requested fallback fragments are left untouched rather than bypassing the exclusion

2.5.17

  • Documentation correction: clarified the 2.5.15 prefix-migration notes so they no longer claim six Premium AJAX/admin-post hook registrations were migrated before the 2.5.16 fix
  • No functional, database, Freemius SDK, or plan/tier behavior changes from 2.5.16

2.5.16

  • Fixed six Premium AJAX/admin-post hook registrations that were still listening on legacy dal_* action names after the 2.5.15 prefix migration
  • Premium search, bulk toggle, click tracking, CSV export and CSV import now register the same dawnal_* action names used by their callers

2.5.15

  • Migrated functions, constants, globals, options, post meta, AJAX action callers and asset handles to the unique dawnal_ prefix; six Premium AJAX/admin-post hook registrations remained on legacy dal_* names and were corrected in 2.5.16; existing settings migrate automatically on update
  • Main-title linking now escapes the full returned title
  • Fixed rule URLs containing query strings (&) being double-encoded in rendered links
  • Updated Plugin URI and Author URI

2.5.14

  • Fixed Premium Add/Edit Rule handling so duplicate keywords show an error instead of a false success message
  • Added direct capability checks to Premium Analytics and Upgrade content handlers
  • Treats leading-slash relative URLs as internal links in Premium URL classification
  • Updated a stale Developer-only AJAX comment; no Free-tier behavior or Freemius packaging changes
